name: unpaged
description: Unpaged plugins for Claude Code and GitHub Copilot: the plan your agent just made, rendered as a whiteboard your team can navigate and comment on, with @agent comments delivered automatically to the session — and, when the code is done, the as-built record of what shipped and why, nested under the plan. Plus the repository's architecture document, drawn from the code and compared with it when you ask.

plugins.name: unpaged
plugins.description: Turn Claude Code and GitHub Copilot plans into whiteboards on Unpaged — review on the canvas, comment on the pieces (@agent comments are delivered automatically to the session inside Claude Code or GitHub Copilot, with a line above the prompt in Claude Code showing what it listens to), approval flips the canvas to executing; the session keeps a Decision log while it builds, attaches a Can view invite link and preview to the branch's GitHub pull request, and /unpaged:as-built compiles the record of what shipped and why under the plan. Every plan is filed in a Visual plans folder. /unpaged:architecture draws the repository's architecture document from its code; when you ask (the compare button on the line above the prompt, or /unpaged:architecture compare), the agent compares the two and marks the canvas when it no longer holds, with update to rewrite it.
